name: Jellyfin Federation Plex
description: Plex libraries, Companion connections and Plex metadata for Jellyfin Federation
overview: Adds Plex catalogs, Companion connections, Plex metadata and guided imports, and .strm export to Jellyfin Federation. Requires the Jellyfin Federation plugin at exactly the same version; Jellyfin friends do not need it.
changelog: First standalone build: installs like any plugin instead of copying a DLL into the Federation plugin folder.
